timeline.body:
- Fix https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/issues/114845
- **More importantly!** Fix EsqlNodeSubclassTests _so that they also test the Node subclasses in esql.core._

Due to a subtle mistake when copying the ql project into esql.core, the EsqlNodeSubclassTests did not run on subclasses in esql.core _at all_. This adds a fix to EsqlNodeSubclassTests.subclassesOf.

The classes ReferenceAttribute, FieldAttribute and MetadataAttribute did not respect the contract for Node.info because their info method did not use the longest public constructor - this is https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/issues/114845. This is fixed here as well.
This prevented the `esql.core` classes from being tested and allowed the contract breaches to slip through.
Neither the data type nor the qualifier are needed - the longest public c'tor doesn't use them and the `info` method shouldn't, either.
Removed just the qualifier that was always `null`. Same for `ReferenceAttribute`.
